## The Policy Challenge

An international policy think tank is preparing a briefing on how countries change as they develop. Some policymakers are interested in whether rising incomes are closely tied to longer lives. 
Others want to know whether higher incomes are associated with greater urbanisation and the pressures that come with it, such as demand for housing, transport, and public services.

Your team has been given a set of messy country-level datasets, but the files are spread across multiple tables and are not yet ready for analysis. 
Your task is to work out what kind of variation the data contain, turn them into a usable dataset, and produce clear evidence that can support a short policy brief.

### R packages for today

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggokabeito)
```
